BasicAuth.description: Username and password for a source that needs them.

Compute.description: A virtualised compute resource: a virtual machine.

computeId.description: Identifier of the compute resource: a UUID assigned by the VIM.

computeName.description: Name of the compute resource, given by the consumer; not unique.

disks.description:
Disks of the compute resource: its own disks (the boot disk and the disks from the flavour,
identified by disk name, deleted with the compute resource and not in the storage API) and
attached volumes (identified by their volume_id).

flavourId.description: Flavour the compute resource is sized by; it needs exactly one boot storage attribute.

hostId.description: Host the compute resource runs on (the Kubernetes node).

imageId.description: Software image the compute resource boots from.

metadata.description: Metadata set by the consumer and by the VIM; for keys under "kubevim.kubenfv.io/" that the VIM maintains, its value wins.

networkInterfaces.description:
Network interfaces, the management interface first; no other order is guaranteed, in the response
or in the guest. Match interfaces by name, MAC address or guest PCI address.

operationalState.description: Operational state of the compute resource.

placementGroupIds.description: Placement groups the compute resource belongs to, joined at creation.

restartRequired.description: A change (a flavour beyond the hotplug limits, or interfaces of a VM that cannot live-migrate) applies on the next restart.

runningState.description: Running state of the compute resource.

statusDetail.description: Human-readable reason when the running state is FAILED.

virtualCpu.description: Virtual CPUs of the compute resource.

virtualMemory.description: Virtual memory of the compute resource.

zoneId.description: Resource zone of the compute resource.

ComputeOperation.description:
Operation on the running state of a compute resource (IFA006 7.3.1.6).
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

ComputeRunningState.description:
Running state of a compute resource.
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

ComputeSnapshot.description: A snapshot of a compute resource (KubeVirt VirtualMachineSnapshot).

computeId.description:
Compute resource the snapshot was taken of. The snapshot is kept when the compute resource is
deleted; the VIM then sets the metadata key "kubevim.kubenfv.io/source-deleted" to "true".

metadata.description: Metadata set by the consumer and by the VIM; for keys under "kubevim.kubenfv.io/" that the VIM maintains, its value wins.

snapshotId.description: Identifier of the snapshot: a UUID assigned by the VIM.

snapshotName.description: Name of the snapshot, given by the consumer; not unique.

ComputeUpdate.description:
Changes to a compute resource: a patch. The name is replaced when set, metadata entries are
merged, and interfaces are added (hotplug) or removed by name.

metadata.description: Metadata entries to add, or to overwrite when the key exists; keys not given are kept, and none is removed.

networkInterfaceNamesToRemove.description: Names of network interfaces to remove.

ContainerFormat.description:
Container format of a software image file.
Values may be added as CDI support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

CpuArchitecture.description:
CPU architecture.
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

DiskBus.description:
Bus a boot disk is attached to.
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

DiskFormat.description:
Disk format of a software image.
Values may be added as CDI support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

Firmware.description:
Firmware a software image boots with.
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

Flavour.description: Memory, CPU and storage of the compute resources created from it.

flavourId.description: Identifier of the flavour: a UUID assigned by the VIM.

flavourName.description: Name of the flavour, given by the consumer; not unique.

metadata.description: Metadata set by the consumer and by the VIM; for keys under "kubevim.kubenfv.io/" that the VIM maintains, its value wins.

storageAttributes.description:
Storage of the compute resource: the boot disk (is_boot) and further disks, created with
each compute resource. A compute resource needs exactly one boot disk.

GlanceSource.description: Image in the Glance catalog configured in the VIM; the VIM holds the Glance endpoint and credentials.

glanceImageId.description: Identifier of the image in Glance.

HttpSource.description: HTTP or HTTPS download. Only one of basicAuth, credentialsRef may be set.

basicAuth.description: Inline username and password; never returned.

caBundle.description: PEM CA bundle to verify the server certificate.

credentialsRef.description: Name of a credential set the VIM loads from its own environment or files; the request carries no secret.

extraHeaders.description: Extra request headers, as "Name: value"; never returned, since they may carry secrets.

Image.description: A software image in the image repository managed by the VIM.

containerFormat.description: Container format of the software image file; unspecified when the VIM cannot tell.

createdAt.description: Time the software image was created.

diskBus.description: Bus the boot disk is attached to; virtio when unset.

diskFormat.description: Disk format of the software image; unspecified when the VIM cannot tell.

firmware.description: Firmware the image boots with; the VIM default (EFI) when unset.

imageId.description: Identifier of the software image: a UUID assigned by the VIM.

importPolicy.description: When the VIM imports the software image; IMPORT_POLICY_EAGER when unset on creation.

metadata.description: Metadata set by the consumer and by the VIM; for keys under "kubevim.kubenfv.io/" that the VIM maintains, its value wins.

minDisk.description:
Minimal disk size for the software image, in Kubernetes quantity format (e.g. "10Gi"); the VIM rejects a
compute resource whose boot disk is smaller.

minRam.description:
Minimal RAM size for the software image, in Kubernetes quantity format (e.g. "2Gi"); the VIM rejects a
compute resource with less memory.

name.description: Name of the software image, given by the consumer; not unique.

progress.description: Import progress in percent while the status is IMAGE_STATUS_IMPORTING.

size.description: Size of the software image, in Kubernetes quantity format; empty until imported.

source.description: Where the VIM imports the software image from; images of a catalog backend name their catalog entry.

statusDetail.description: Human-readable reason when the status is IMAGE_STATUS_FAILED.

updatedAt.description: Time the software image was last updated.

ImageSource.description: Source of a software image; exactly one member is set.

glance.description: Import an image of the Glance catalog configured in the VIM.

local.description: Import an image file of the local catalog configured in the VIM.

s3.description: Download from an S3-compatible object store.

ImageSourceType.description:
Image source type, as reported by ListImageSources.
Values may be added as CDI support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

upload.description: Upload by the client after creation.

ImageStatus.description:
Status of a software image.
Values may be added as CDI support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

ImageUpdate.description: Changes to a software image: a patch. The name is replaced when set; metadata entries are merged.

metadata.description: Metadata entries to add, or to overwrite when the key exists; keys not given are kept, and none is removed.

ImportPolicy.description: When the VIM imports a software image.

IpAddressPool.description: Range of addresses a subnet allocates from.

IpAssignment.description: How a network interface gets its addresses.

IpVersion.description: IP version of a network or subnet (IFA006 8.4.4.4).

LocalSource.description: Image file in the local catalog directory configured in the VIM.

fileName.description: Name of the file in the catalog directory, without a path.

Network.description: A virtualised network: one layer 2 segment, with at most one IPv4 and one IPv6 subnet.

layer3Attributes.description:
Subnets created with the network, in one call that rolls back as a whole: at most one per
IP version. A Kube-OVN network needs at least one; GENEVE networks always use Kube-OVN.

metadata.description: Metadata set by the consumer and by the VIM; for keys under "kubevim.kubenfv.io/" that the VIM maintains, its value wins.

mtu.description: MTU of the network in bytes; the VIM default when unset.

networkId.description: Identifier of the network: a UUID assigned by the VIM.

networkName.description: Name of the network, given by the consumer; not unique.

networkType.description: How traffic of the network is separated.

providerNetwork.description:
Name of a provider network declared in the VIM configuration, which also sets its backend
(Kube-OVN or SR-IOV); required for VLAN and FLAT networks, absent for GENEVE.

segmentationId.description: VLAN ID of a VLAN network; absent for GENEVE and FLAT networks.

subnetIds.description: Subnets of the network: at most one per IP version.

NetworkInterfaceData.description: A network interface requested for a compute resource.

bandwidth.description: Rate limit in Mbps; 0 means no limit.

ipAddresses.description: Addresses for the static assignment: at most one per IP version; a family left out is allocated automatically.

ipAssignment.description: How the interface gets its addresses; automatic when unset.

macAddress.description: MAC address; the VIM assigns one when unset.

model.description: NIC model the guest sees; virtio when unset.

name.description: Name of the interface, unique within the compute resource; the VIM chooses one when unset.

networkId.description: Network to attach to; the interface gets one address per subnet of the network.

NetworkType.description:
How traffic of a network is separated.
Values may be added as backends grow; clients should accept unknown values.

NetworkUpdate.description: Changes to a network: a patch. The name is replaced when set; metadata entries are merged.

metadata.description: Metadata entries to add, or to overwrite when the key exists; keys not given are kept, and none is removed.

NicModel.description:
NIC model the guest sees.
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

OperationalState.description: Operational state of a virtualised resource (IFA006).

PlacementEnforcement.description: Whether a placement policy must hold.

PlacementGroup.description: A group of compute resources placed together or apart (decision 0005).

enforcement.description: Whether the policy must hold or is applied when possible; PLACEMENT_ENFORCEMENT_REQUIRED when unset.

metadata.description: Metadata set by the consumer and by the VIM; for keys under "kubevim.kubenfv.io/" that the VIM maintains, its value wins.

placementGroupId.description: Identifier of the group: a UUID assigned by the VIM.

placementGroupName.description: Name of the group, given by the consumer; not unique.

scope.description: Topology domain the policy applies to; PLACEMENT_SCOPE_NODE when unset.

type.description: Whether members are placed together or apart.

PlacementScope.description:
Topology domain a placement policy applies to.
Values may be added; clients should accept unknown values.

PlacementType.description: Whether members of a placement group are placed together or apart.

type.description: https://kubevim.kubenfv.io/problems/<reason>, the error reason (ErrorReason in the protos) in kebab case, e.g. .../problems/resource-in-use; about:blank for authentication and authorisation errors. Clients should accept unknown types.

RegistrySource.description: Container registry pull. Only one of basicAuth, credentialsRef may be set.

basicAuth.description: Inline username and password; never returned.

caBundle.description: PEM CA bundle to verify the registry certificate.

credentialsRef.description: Name of a credential set the VIM loads from its own environment or files; the request carries no secret.

platform.description: Platform of a multi-architecture image, e.g. "linux/arm64".

pullMethod.description: Pull method; the VIM default when unset.

S3AccessKey.description: Access key for an S3-compatible object store.

S3Source.description: S3-compatible object store download. Only one of accessKey, credentialsRef may be set.

caBundle.description: PEM CA bundle to verify the endpoint certificate.

credentialsRef.description: Name of a credential set the VIM loads from its own environment or files; the request carries no secret.

SnapshotStatus.description:
Status of a snapshot.
Values may be added as snapshot support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

Subnet.description: A virtualised subnet: one IP version of a network.

metadata.description: Metadata set by the consumer and by the VIM; for keys under "kubevim.kubenfv.io/" that the VIM maintains, its value wins.

subnetId.description: Identifier of the subnet: a UUID assigned by the VIM.

subnetName.description: Name of the subnet, given by the consumer; not unique.

SubnetData.description: Layer 3 attributes of a subnet: one IP version of its network.

addressPools.description: Address pools the VIM allocates from; the whole CIDR except the gateway when empty.

cidr.description: Network address and prefix length, e.g. "10.0.0.0/24".

dnsServers.description: DNS servers handed out by DHCP.

gatewayIp.description: Gateway address; the VIM picks one when unset.

isDhcpEnabled.description: DHCP is enabled; unset means true.

SubnetUpdate.description: Changes to a subnet: a patch. The name is replaced when set; metadata entries are merged.

metadata.description: Metadata entries to add, or to overwrite when the key exists; keys not given are kept, and none is removed.

TypeOfStorage.description:
Type of a virtualised storage resource.
Values may be added as Kubernetes storage support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

TypeVirtualNic.description:
How a network interface is realised.
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

UploadSource.description:
Upload by the client. Create the image with this source, then send the
image file to upload_url with upload_token before upload_expire_time.

uploadExpireTime.description: Time after which the token is no longer accepted.

uploadToken.description: Bearer token for the upload request.

uploadUrl.description: URL to upload the image file to.

UserData.description: User data passed to the compute resource at boot time.

content.description: User data, e.g. a cloud-init document; transparent to the VIM.

method.description: How the content reaches the guest; NoCloud when unset.

UserDataTransportationMethod.description:
How user data reaches the guest.
Values may be added as KubeVirt support grows; clients should accept unknown values.

VirtualCpu.description: Virtual CPUs of a compute resource.

cpuArchitecture.description: CPU architecture; the VIM default when unset.

topology.description:
Guest CPU topology; the product of its fields equals num_virtual_cpu. The VIM rejects a
topology its backend cannot express (KubeVirt takes the vCPU count and a preferred layout).

VirtualCpuPinning.description: CPU pinning of a compute resource.

VirtualCpuPinningPolicy.description:
CPU pinning policy (IFA006 8.4.2.4). IFA's STATIC policy with explicit rules is left out:
KubeVirt places dedicated CPUs itself.

VirtualMemory.description: Virtual memory of a compute resource.

hugepageSize.description: Hugepage size backing the memory; empty for regular pages.

virtualMemSize.description: Amount of memory, in Kubernetes quantity format.

hugepageSize.description: Hugepage size backing the memory, "2Mi" or "1Gi"; regular pages when unset.

numaEnabled.description: Memory is allocated on the NUMA nodes of the pinned CPUs; needs dynamic pinning and hugepages.

virtualMemOversubscriptionPolicy.description: Memory oversubscription as "<virtual>:<physical>", at least 1:1, e.g. "2:1" (KubeVirt overcommitPercent).

virtualMemSize.description: Amount of memory, in Kubernetes quantity format (e.g. "4Gi").

VirtualNetworkInterface.description: A network interface of a compute resource.

bandwidth.description: Rate limit in Mbps; 0 when not limited.

computeId.description: Compute resource the interface belongs to.

guestInterfaceName.description: Interface name in the guest, e.g. "eth1"; empty when the guest agent does not report it.

guestPciAddress.description: PCI address of the device in the guest; empty until known.

hostPciAddress.description: PCI address of the device on the host, for SR-IOV interfaces.

ipAddresses.description: Addresses of the interface, one per subnet of its network; may be empty until DHCP or the guest configures them.

isManagement.description: The management interface every compute resource gets on the pod network.

name.description: Name of the interface, unique within the compute resource: the one given at creation, or one the VIM chose.

networkId.description: Network the interface is attached to; empty for the management interface.

operationalState.description: ENABLED once the interface is attached and ready.

VirtualStorageData.description: Size, type and capabilities of a virtualised storage resource.

isBoot.description: The software image is copied to this storage and the compute resource boots from it.

sizeOfStorage.description: Size of the storage resource, in Kubernetes quantity format (e.g. "20Gi").

storageClass.description: Kubernetes storage class of the storage, one labelled kubevim.kubenfv.io/storage=true; the VIM default when unset.

Volume.description: A virtualised storage resource, e.g. a disk of a compute resource.

computeId.description: Compute resource that uses the volume; empty when not attached.

hostId.description: Host of the volume; empty for distributed storage.

metadata.description: Metadata set by the consumer and by the VIM; for keys under "kubevim.kubenfv.io/" that the VIM maintains, its value wins.

storageData.description: Size, type and capabilities of the volume.

volumeId.description:
Identifier of the volume: a UUID assigned by the VIM for volumes created with the storage API.
The own disks of a compute resource (its boot disk and the disks from its flavour) are not
resources of their own and use their disk name instead.

volumeName.description: Name of the volume, given by the consumer; not unique.

VolumeSnapshot.description: A snapshot of a volume (Kubernetes VolumeSnapshot).

metadata.description: Metadata set by the consumer and by the VIM; for keys under "kubevim.kubenfv.io/" that the VIM maintains, its value wins.

snapshotId.description: Identifier of the snapshot: a UUID assigned by the VIM.

snapshotName.description: Name of the snapshot, given by the consumer; not unique.

volumeId.description:
Volume the snapshot was taken of. The snapshot is kept when the volume is deleted; the VIM
then sets the metadata key "kubevim.kubenfv.io/source-deleted" to "true".
